features.name: Placement Readiness Dashboard
features.whatItDoes: Central analytics hub predicting your probability of campus placement (0-100%) using a calibrated Random Forest model trained on 972 historical student records. Includes HeroMetrics, continuous What-If Career Trajectory Simulator, and Live GitHub Fraud Shield.
features.whoItIsFor: Every engineering student wanting an immediate, data-backed assessment of their placement standing and projected CTC salary tier.
howToUse: Step 1: Check your Placement Readiness gauge and key metrics (CGPA, Coding score, Backlogs, Communication) on the Hero banner.
Step 2: Scroll to the What-If Sandbox to drag sliders and see how solving more LeetCode problems or shipping projects boosts your CTC in real time.

features.name: Readiness Command Hub
features.whatItDoes: Tactical action engine that translates your skill gaps into immediate high-impact tasks, diagnostic audits, and focused preparation sprints.
features.whoItIsFor: Students looking for actionable daily directives instead of passive dashboards.
howToUse: Step 1: Review your prioritized Next Actions cards tailored to your target role.
Step 2: Click 'Launch Diagnostic' or 'Start Sprint' to immediately execute that preparation task.

features.name: 6-Week Placement Roadmap & Missions
features.whatItDoes: Constructs an adaptive semester-by-semester 6-week milestone roadmap targeting your dream role, detailing DSA patterns, CS core subjects, and project builds for each week.
features.whoItIsFor: Students preparing for campus drive seasons who need a clear week-by-week study syllabus.
howToUse: Step 1: Inspect the current week's mission deliverables and recommended study resources.
Step 2: Mark completed weekly milestones to advance your preparation progress and recalibrate odds.

features.name: AI Career Coach & Voice Interviewer
features.whatItDoes: Screen-aware, bilingual (English & Telugu) conversational AI mentor and real-time voice mock interviewer powered by Gemini Flash. Evaluates candidate answers using the STAR method, analyzes speech cadence, and tracks filler words.
features.whoItIsFor: Students practicing technical viva, behavioral rounds, or needing quick senior guidance on projects, roles, and resume doubts.
howToUse: Step 1: Click the microphone button and select your language (English, Telugu, or Hindi).
Step 2: Answer the interview questions aloud to receive real-time sentence-by-sentence voice feedback and clarity scores.

features.name: Project Blueprints Catalog (23 Architectures)
features.whatItDoes: Curated catalog of 23 production-grade portfolio architectures (6 flagship + 17 Smart India Hackathon blueprints) with difficulty tiers, component stacks, system schemas, and viva defense talking points.
features.whoItIsFor: Students wanting to replace tutorial clones with high-impact, recruiter-ready full-stack, AI, and embedded architectures.
howToUse: Step 1: Filter projects by your branch or difficulty level (Small, Medium, Hard).
Step 2: Click on any blueprint card to open its step-by-step build order, architecture diagram, and Google X-Y-Z resume bullet.

features.name: Cohort Analytics & TPO Command Center
features.whatItDoes: Analyzes 972 verified student placement records across 9 engineering disciplines. Features an institutional TPO mode with early-warning at-risk student tracking and 1-click NAAC Criterion 5.2.1 / NIRF compliance reports.
features.whoItIsFor: Students researching branch hiring cutoffs, and college Placement Officers (TPOs) conducting accreditation audits.
howToUse: Step 1: Use the interactive dropdowns to filter by graduation year, engineering branch, and skill domain.
Step 2: Switch to 'TPO & NAAC 5.2' mode to audit at-risk candidate cohorts or export the printable compliance report.

features.name: ATS Resume Studio & Resume Builder
features.whatItDoes: Multimodal PDF resume intelligence that benchmarks your resume against Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and TCS recruitment standards. Includes 1-click profile sync and a built-in one-page ATS Resume Builder.
features.whoItIsFor: Students optimizing their CV to clear automated ATS applicant screening algorithms.
howToUse: Step 1: Drag and drop your PDF resume to generate ATS compatibility scores and missing keyword breakdowns.
Step 2: Click 'Sync Keywords to Profile' or 'Build Resume' to generate and download an ATS-compliant 1-page PDF resume.

features.name: Branch Intelligence & Course Trends
features.whatItDoes: Presents comparative departmental placement statistics, salary distributions, and high-converting course trends across 9 engineering branches (CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, MECH, CIVIL, AIML, CSD).
features.whoItIsFor: Students comparing branch-specific recruitment trends or non-CS students targeting software roles.
howToUse: Step 1: Select your target department from the branch selector.
Step 2: Review median packages, top recruiter patterns, and core technical courses driving placement conversion.

features.name: Project Architecture Defense Simulator
features.whatItDoes: Simulates Round 2 technical interview architecture questioning, testing system design choices, caching strategies, and edge-case failure handling for your portfolio project.
features.whoItIsFor: Final year students preparing for rigorous technical interview rounds.
howToUse: Step 1: Select your project architecture blueprint.
Step 2: Defend your design against the interviewer's failure scenarios and receive instant STAR scoring.

features.name: Candidate Profile & Settings (SSOT)
features.whatItDoes: Single Source of Truth (SSOT) managing your academic records (CGPA, backlogs, branch), coding handles (GitHub, LeetCode), and target company compensation tiers.
features.whoItIsFor: Students updating their profile parameters to recalibrate all AI prediction models.
howToUse: Step 1: Update your academic details, verified skills, or coding profile links.
Step 2: Click 'Save Profile' to immediately synchronize changes across all AI features.
